recipes.title: Green Curry
recipes.description: Classic Thai curry with spicy green curry paste, coconut milk and Thai basil. Balanced between spicy, sweet and salty.
instructions: Heat some coconut milk in a pan and fry the curry paste until fragrant
Add chicken and cook until it changes color
Add remaining coconut milk and bring to a boil
Add eggplants and cook for 10 minutes
Season with fish sauce and sugar
Add basil and chili before serving

recipes.title: Red Curry
recipes.description: Rich and spicy curry with red curry paste, tender beef and colorful vegetables. Famous dish in Thailand.
instructions: Fry curry paste in some coconut milk until fragrant
Add beef and fry until it changes color
Add remaining coconut milk and kaffir lime leaves
Cook over medium heat for 25 minutes
Add bell pepper and bamboo
Season with fish sauce and sugar and cook for 5 more minutes

recipes.title: Massaman Curry
recipes.description: Rich curry with Persian-Indian influence with peanuts, potatoes and warm spices. Relatively sweet and mild.
instructions: Fry curry paste in some coconut milk
Add chicken and fry for 5 minutes
Add remaining coconut milk, fish sauce and sugar
Cook over low heat for 45 minutes
Add chopped potatoes and onion
Cook for 30 more minutes until potatoes are tender
Add peanuts and kaffir lime leaves before serving

recipes.title: Panang Curry
recipes.description: Thick and rich curry with panang curry paste, concentrated coconut milk and pork or chicken. Less spicy and sweeter.
instructions: Heat half the coconut milk and fry the curry paste
Add chicken and fry until it changes color
Add remaining coconut milk and bring to a gentle boil
Season with fish sauce and sugar
Add kaffir lime leaves and chopped bell pepper
Cook for 15 minutes until thick, add basil before serving

recipes.title: Yellow Curry
recipes.description: Mild curry with turmeric, coconut milk and potatoes. Influenced by Indian cuisine, with mild and pleasant flavor.
instructions: Fry curry paste in some coconut milk
Add chopped chicken and fry until it changes color
Add coconut milk, potatoes and onion
Season with fish sauce and sugar
Cook for 25 minutes until potatoes are tender
Serve with jasmine rice

recipes.title: Jungle Curry
recipes.description: Spicy curry without coconut milk, traditional from northern region. Full of fresh vegetables and chili.
instructions: Heat some oil and fry the curry paste
Add chicken broth and bring to a boil
Add chicken and cook for 10 minutes
Add all vegetables
Season with fish sauce and cook for 10 minutes
Add basil and fresh chili before serving

recipes.title: Chu Chee Curry
recipes.description: Thick and rich curry served over fish or seafood. With concentrated spicy coconut sauce.
instructions: Fry curry paste in some coconut milk
Add remaining coconut milk and bring to a boil
Season with fish sauce and sugar
Add salmon and cook for 8-10 minutes
Add kaffir lime leaves and chili
Serve with jasmine rice

recipes.title: Sour Curry
recipes.description: Traditional sour curry from southern Thailand with tamarind, fish and vegetables. Unique sour-spicy flavor.
instructions: Bring water to a boil and add curry paste
Add tamarind, fish sauce and sugar
Add vegetables and cook for 10 minutes
Add fish and cook for 8 minutes
Taste and adjust sourness as desired
Serve hot with rice

recipes.title: Pineapple Curry
recipes.description: Sweet red curry with fresh pineapple, seafood and coconut milk. Unique combination of sweet and spicy.
instructions: Fry curry paste in some coconut milk
Add more coconut milk and bring to a boil
Add shrimp and cook for 5 minutes
Add pineapple and tomatoes
Season with fish sauce and sugar
Add basil and serve

recipes.title: Muslim Curry
recipes.description: Rich curry with Muslim influence with warm spices, lamb and potatoes. Seasoned with cardamom and cinnamon.
instructions: Fry curry paste with spices in some coconut milk
Add lamb and fry until it changes color
Add coconut milk and cook over low heat for 45 minutes
Add potatoes and onions
Cook for 25 more minutes
Season with fish sauce and sugar
Serve with rice or roti

recipes.title: Pad Krapow
recipes.description: Classic Thai basil dish with ground pork, chili and garlic. Served with fried egg and rice.
instructions: Pound garlic and chili together
Heat oil in a pan over high heat
Fry garlic and chili until fragrant
Add meat and fry until it changes color
Season with fish sauce, soy sauce and sugar
Add basil and fry until wilted
Fry eggs in a separate pan and serve over rice with the meat

recipes.title: Pad See Ew
recipes.description: Wide rice noodles stir-fried with Chinese broccoli, egg and dark soy sauce. Deep and smoky flavor.
instructions: Soak noodles in hot water until soft
Heat pan over very high heat
Fry garlic and chicken until it changes color
Push to the side, crack egg and fry
Add noodles and broccoli
Add sauces and sugar
Fry quickly until noodles get color

recipes.title: Pad Khing
recipes.description: Ginger stir-fry with chicken, mushrooms and green onions. Aromatic and perfectly seasoned.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over high heat
Fry garlic and ginger until fragrant
Add chicken and fry until it changes color
Add mushrooms and bell pepper
Season with sauces and sugar
Add green onions and fry for one more minute
Serve immediately with steamed rice

recipes.title: Pad Prik King
recipes.description: Red curry paste stir-fry with green beans and meat. Spicy and aromatic with crispy texture.
instructions: Heat oil and fry curry paste until fragrant
Add meat and fry until it changes color
Add green beans and kaffir lime leaves
Season with fish sauce and sugar
Fry until beans are tender but crisp
Serve immediately

recipes.title: Pad Woon Sen
recipes.description: Glass noodles stir-fried with vegetables, egg and meat. Light and healthy with mild flavor.
instructions: Soak noodles in hot water for 10 minutes
Heat oil in a pan and fry chicken
Add vegetables and fry for 3 minutes
Push to the side and crack egg
Add drained noodles
Season with sauces and sugar
Mix everything and fry for 2 minutes

recipes.title: Pad Pak Ruam
recipes.description: Mixed vegetables stir-fry with oyster sauce. Colorful, healthy and full of flavor.
instructions: Cut all vegetables to similar sizes
Heat pan over high heat
Fry garlic until fragrant
Add vegetables by cooking time (hard before soft)
Season with sauces and sugar
Fry until vegetables are tender but crisp
Serve immediately

recipes.title: Pad Cha
recipes.description: Spicy seafood stir-fry with chili peppers, ginger and Thai basil. Rare and special dish.
instructions: Heat pan over very high heat
Fry garlic, chili and ginger
Add seafood and fry quickly
Add fish sauce and sugar
Add kaffir lime leaves and basil
Fry for 2 more minutes and serve

recipes.title: Pad Gratiem
recipes.description: Garlic and black pepper stir-fry with pork or chicken. Simple, aromatic and full of flavor.
instructions: Pound garlic coarsely
Heat oil in a pan over high heat
Fry garlic until golden
Add meat and black pepper
Fry until meat is cooked
Season with sauces and sugar
Serve with rice and fresh vegetables

recipes.title: Pad Med Mamuang
recipes.description: Chicken stir-fry with cashews, bell peppers and dried onions. Slightly sweet with crispy roasted cashews.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over high heat
Fry garlic and dried chili
Add chicken and fry until it changes color
Add bell pepper and dried onions
Season with sauces and sugar
Add cashews and fry for one more minute
Serve immediately

recipes.title: Pad Thai
recipes.description: Thailand's famous noodle dish with tamarind, shrimp, peanuts and fried bean sprouts.
instructions: Soak noodles in hot water for 30 minutes
Heat pan over high heat
Fry tofu until golden and set aside
Crack eggs and fry into omelet, cut into strips
Fry shrimp until pink
Add noodles, tamarind, fish sauce and sugar
Add bean sprouts, green onions and tofu
Serve with peanuts, lime and chili

recipes.title: Tom Yum Goong
recipes.description: Sour-spicy shrimp soup with lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves and galangal. Thailand's most famous soup.
instructions: Bring broth to a boil
Add lemongrass, galangal and kaffir lime leaves
Cook for 5 minutes to extract flavors
Add mushrooms and tomatoes
Add shrimp and cook for 5 minutes
Season with chili paste and fish sauce
Turn off heat and add lime juice and fresh chili
Serve immediately

recipes.title: Tom Kha Gai
recipes.description: Chicken coconut soup with galangal, lemongrass and mushrooms. Mild, creamy and comforting.
instructions: Bring chicken broth to a boil
Add galangal, lemongrass and kaffir lime leaves
Cook for 5 minutes
Add chopped chicken and cook for 10 minutes
Add coconut milk and mushrooms
Season with fish sauce
Turn off heat and add lime juice and chili
Serve hot

recipes.title: Tom Saap
recipes.description: Spicy soup from northeastern Thailand with many herbs and intense sour-spicy flavor.
instructions: Cook bones in water for 20 minutes
Add lemongrass, galangal and cilantro roots
Cook for 10 more minutes
Strain the broth
Return to pot and add kaffir lime leaves
Season with fish sauce and chili
Turn off heat and add lime juice and dill
Serve boiling hot

recipes.title: Gaeng Jued
recipes.description: Mild clear soup with tofu, vegetables and ground pork. Balanced and comforting.
instructions: Bring broth to a boil
Add crushed garlic
Roll small meatballs from ground pork and add to broth
Cook for 5 minutes
Add tofu and cabbage
Cook for 5 more minutes
Season with soy sauce and pepper
Add green onions and serve

recipes.title: Tom Yum Pla
recipes.description: Sour-spicy fish soup with vegetables and Thai herbs. Fish version of tom yum.
instructions: Bring broth to a boil with lemongrass and galangal
Cook for 5 minutes
Add mushrooms and tomatoes
Add fish cut into cubes
Cook gently for 8 minutes
Season with fish sauce and chili paste
Turn off heat and add lime juice
Serve immediately

recipes.title: Kaeng Liang
recipes.description: Thai vegetable soup with shrimp paste and spices. Healthy, light and full of flavor.
instructions: Bring broth to a boil
Add shrimp paste and mix
Add pumpkin and cook for 10 minutes
Add green beans and cabbage
Add shrimp and cook for 5 minutes
Season with fish sauce
Add basil and serve

recipes.title: Tom Som
recipes.description: Refreshing sour soup with fish or shrimp. Similar to tom yum but more sour and less spicy.
instructions: Bring broth to a boil with lemongrass
Add tamarind, fish sauce and sugar
Add tomatoes and onion
Cook for 10 minutes
Add chopped fish
Cook for 8 minutes until fish is done
Taste and adjust sourness
Serve hot

recipes.title: Khao Tom
recipes.description: Comforting Thai rice soup, served for breakfast or when sick. Simple and comforting.
instructions: Bring broth to a boil
Add garlic and ginger
Add cooked rice
Cook over low heat for 20 minutes
Add ground pork and cook for 5 minutes
Crack egg and add to soup while stirring
Season with soy sauce
Serve with green onions and fried garlic

recipes.title: Jok
recipes.description: Thai rice porridge with ground pork, egg and pickled vegetables. Perfect comfort food.
instructions: Bring broth and ginger to a boil
Add rice
Cook over low heat for 40 minutes, stirring occasionally
Add ground pork and cook for 5 minutes
Season with soy sauce
Serve with century eggs, green onions and fried garlic

recipes.title: Gaeng Om
recipes.description: Herbal soup from Isan region with dill, basil and meat. Aromatic and full of flavor.
instructions: Bring broth to a boil
Add chopped beef and cook for 20 minutes
Add lemongrass and eggplants
Season with fish sauce and chili paste
Cook for 10 more minutes
Add fresh dill and basil
Turn off heat and serve immediately

recipes.title: Som Tam
recipes.description: Spicy green papaya salad with peanuts, tomatoes and fish sauce. The most popular street food dish.
instructions: Pound garlic and chili in a mortar
Add sugar and continue pounding
Add green beans and tomatoes and pound gently
Add papaya and mix gently
Add lime juice and fish sauce
Add peanuts and mix
Taste and adjust seasoning
Serve immediately with sticky rice

recipes.title: Satay
recipes.description: Meat skewers in coconut milk and spices, served with peanut sauce. Classic street food.
instructions: Cut chicken into strips and thread on skewers
Mix coconut milk, curry paste, sugar and soy sauce
Marinate skewers for 2 hours
Prepare sauce: mix peanut butter, coconut milk, tamarind and sugar
Grill skewers on grill or in pan
Serve with peanut sauce, cucumber and radish

recipes.title: Larb
recipes.description: Spicy crumbled meat salad with mint, cilantro and toasted ground rice. Traditional dish from Isan region.
instructions: Cook ground meat until it changes color
Turn off heat and add lime juice and fish sauce
Add toasted ground rice
Add sliced shallots, chili and green onions
Add fresh mint and cilantro
Mix well and taste
Serve with fresh vegetables and sticky rice

recipes.title: Moo Ping
recipes.description: Pork skewers marinated in coconut milk and soy sauce, grilled over charcoal. Aromatic and juicy.
instructions: Cut pork into thick strips
Pound cilantro roots and garlic
Mix with coconut milk, soy sauce, sugar and oyster sauce
Marinate meat for 2 hours
Thread on wooden skewers
Grill on grill or pan until golden
Serve with sticky rice and spicy sauce

recipes.title: Mango Sticky Rice
recipes.description: Sticky rice with sweet coconut milk and ripe mango. Thailand's most famous dessert in the world.
instructions: Soak sticky rice in water for 4 hours
Steam rice for 25 minutes until tender
Heat coconut milk with sugar and salt
Mix half the mixture with hot rice
Let absorb for 20 minutes
Slice mango
Serve rice with mango, extra coconut milk and sesame

recipes.title: Gai Yang
recipes.description: Whole grilled chicken marinated in spices and sticky rice. Aromatic, juicy and full of flavor.
instructions: Pound cilantro roots, garlic and pepper
Mix with soy sauce, oyster sauce and sugar
Butterfly chicken and make cuts
Rub marinade on and in the chicken
Marinate for 4 hours or overnight
Grill on grill for 40-45 minutes
Serve with sticky rice and som tam

recipes.title: Khanom Krok
recipes.description: Small Thai coconut pancakes with green onions or sweet corn. Crispy outside and soft inside.
instructions: Mix rice flour, half the coconut milk, sugar and salt
Let batter rest for 30 minutes
Heat khanom krok pan (or mini muffin pan)
Brush with oil and pour batter to halfway
Add topping (onions or corn)
Cover with remaining coconut milk
Bake until bottom is golden and top is creamy

recipes.title: Roti
recipes.description: Thin and crispy Thai pancake with egg, banana and condensed milk sauce. Popular street food.
instructions: Mix flour, egg, milk, sugar and salt into dough
Knead until smooth and let rest for one hour
Divide into balls and coat with oil
Stretch each ball very thin
Fry on pan with butter
Add banana to half the roti
Fold into square and drizzle condensed milk

recipes.title: Khao Man Gai
recipes.description: Steamed chicken with rice in chicken fat and ginger sauce. Most popular lunch dish.
instructions: Cook whole chicken in water with garlic and ginger for 35 minutes
Remove chicken and place in cold water
Fry crushed garlic and ginger in oil
Add rice and fry for one minute
Cook rice in chicken broth
Prepare sauce: garlic, ginger, soy sauce, vinegar and sugar
Slice chicken and serve with rice, cucumber and sauce

recipes.title: Pad Thai Street Style
recipes.description: Traditional street food version of pad thai with dried shrimp and fried radish.
instructions: Soak noodles in hot water
Heat pan over very high heat
Fry shrimp and tofu
Add dried shrimp and radish
Push to side and crack egg
Add noodles, tamarind, fish sauce and sugar
Fry quickly for 2 minutes
Serve with peanuts and bean sprouts

recipes.title: Mango Sticky Rice
recipes.description: Sweet sticky rice with coconut milk and perfectly ripe mango. Thailand's most famous dessert.
instructions: Soak rice in water for 4 hours or overnight
Steam rice for 25 minutes until tender
Heat coconut milk with sugar and salt until sugar dissolves
Mix 3/4 of the mixture with hot rice
Cover and let absorb for 20 minutes
Peel and slice mango beautifully
Serve rice with mango, extra coconut milk and sesame

recipes.title: Khanom Buang
recipes.description: Thin and crispy Thai crepe with meringue foam and sweet or savory toppings. Classic street food.
instructions: Mix flours with coconut milk into thin batter
Prepare meringue: whip egg whites with sugar
Heat special khanom buang pan
Pour thin batter and bake until crispy
Spread meringue on crepe
Sprinkle orange coconut or green onions
Fold in half and serve immediately

recipes.title: Tub Tim Krob
recipes.description: Water chestnut cubes in tapioca flour with coconut milk and crushed ice. Refreshing and special dessert.
instructions: Cut water chestnuts into small cubes
Dip in red coloring
Coat with tapioca flour
Cook in boiling water until they float
Place in cold water
Prepare syrup: cook coconut milk with sugar and salt
Serve chestnuts with coconut syrup and crushed ice

recipes.title: Khao Niao Sangkhaya
recipes.originalName: Khao Niao Sangkhaya (Sticky Rice with Custard)
recipes.description: Sticky rice with egg custard and steamed pumpkin pulp. Traditional rich and creamy dessert.
instructions: Steam sticky rice until done
Mix with half the coconut milk and sugar
Prepare custard: mix eggs, coconut milk and sugar
Clean pumpkin and spread rice inside
Pour custard over rice
Steam for 40 minutes until custard sets
Cool and slice into pieces

recipes.title: Khanom Chan
recipes.description: Thai layered cake in colorful layers with coconut and tapioca flour. Beautiful and special.
instructions: Mix flours, coconut milk, sugar and salt
Divide into 3 bowls and color each differently
Prepare greased pan
Steam first layer for 7 minutes
Add another layer and steam for 7 minutes
Continue until all layers are done
Cool, cut into diamonds and serve

recipes.title: Lod Chong
recipes.description: Green pandan noodles with coconut milk, crushed ice and palm sugar syrup. Refreshing and aromatic.
instructions: Mix flour with pandan juice
Cook until thick
Push through strainer into bowl with ice
Prepare syrup from sugar and water
Heat coconut milk with salt
Serve noodles with syrup, coconut milk, palm sugar syrup and ice

recipes.title: Bua Loi
recipes.originalName: Bua Loi (Sticky Rice Balls in Coconut Milk)
recipes.description: Colorful sticky rice balls in hot coconut milk. Comforting and sweet dessert.
instructions: Mix flour with water into dough
Divide into 3 parts and color each one
Roll small balls
Cook in boiling water until they float
Cook coconut milk with sugar and salt
Add balls to coconut milk
Serve hot with roasted peanuts

recipes.title: Thong Yip
recipes.description: Dessert made from egg yolks and sugar in flower shape. Rich, sweet and especially traditional.
instructions: Beat egg yolks well
Cook sugar and water to thick syrup
Pour yolks through special funnel into syrup
Cook until set
Lift gently and shape into flower
Let cool and serve

recipes.title: Kluay Buat Chi
recipes.originalName: Kluay Buat Chi (Bananas in Coconut Milk)
recipes.description: Bananas in sweet coconut milk with salt. Simple, comforting and perfect.
instructions: Cut bananas into diagonal slices
Heat coconut milk with sugar and salt
Bring to gentle boil
Add bananas and cook for 10 minutes
Serve hot or at room temperature

recipes.title: Khanom Krok Dessert
recipes.description: Small colorful Thai coconut pancakes with sweet toppings. Crispy and creamy.
instructions: Mix rice flour, 300 ml coconut milk, sugar and salt
Let batter rest for 30 minutes
Heat khanom krok pan and brush with oil
Pour batter to half height
Add topping (corn or coconut)
Cover with remaining coconut milk
Bake until bottom is golden and top is creamy
Serve hot
